ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 24-F in
the area bound by:

East 95" Street; South Lafayette Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to East 95"
Street and a line 32.43 feet west of and parallel to South Lafayette Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

pif LB 2b

Anthony A‘ Beale
Alderman, 9" Ward

Common Address:
33 W. 95th Street
